# Sagar Luitel — Full Stack Web Developer & UI/UX Designer

> Portfolio and professional documentation for Sagar Luitel, full stack developer and UI/UX designer based in Pokhara, Nepal.

Sagar Luitel is a freelance full stack web developer and UI/UX designer based in Pokhara, Nepal. He specializes in building fast, fluid, production-ready web experiences using React, Next.js, Three.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and GSAP animations.

## Main Pages

- [Home Page](https://sagarluitel.com): Official portfolio homepage of Sagar Luitel
- [Selected Work](https://sagarluitel.com/work): Detailed showcase of web development, 3D WebGL, and SAAS projects
- [About Sagar](https://sagarluitel.com/about): Background, technical skills, philosophy, and experience
- [Contact](https://sagarluitel.com/contact): Inquire about web development, design, and freelance projects

## Featured Projects

- [3D Bike Configurator](https://mtb1x.vercel.app/): Interactive 3D WebGL bike configurator with dynamic lighting and Draco mesh compression
- [myRestro Manager](https://myrestromanager.vercel.app/): Multi-tenant SAAS restaurant manager with real-time WebSocket order flows and PostgreSQL architecture
- [Save Wildlife](https://savewildlife.vercel.app/): Conservation scrollytelling platform with Nuxt.js, Vue 3, and GSAP ScrollTrigger animations
- [Into Pokhara](https://intopokhara.vercel.app/): Digital tourism scrollytelling experience for Pokhara, Nepal
- [Porsche Concept](https://porscheconcept.vercel.app/): Interactive 3D vehicle showroom with custom WebGL shaders
- [Project Peak](https://projectpeak.vercel.app/): Himalayan travel booking platform with Mapbox GL JS and React
- [Dobby Haircare](https://dobby-indol.vercel.app/): Headless luxury haircare store built with Shopify Storefront API and Redux Toolkit
- [Digital Voting Portal](https://github.com/sagarluiteldev/Digital-Voting): Decentralized voting dApp using Solidity smart contracts and EIP-712 meta-transactions
- [CityScape](https://cityscapeny.vercel.app/): NYC apartment rental portal with React, Vite, and Framer Motion
- [Navyata](https://navyata.vercel.app/): Fashion e-commerce boutique with Shopify Storefront API
- [Viatour](https://via-tour.vercel.app/): Full-stack travel booking application with Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Stripe API
